title: fix: show API default in chat model banner
author: ale-rls
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #16430

- Shows `API default` in the chat banner when `--model` is omitted, replacing `undefined`.
- Corrects help to describe the existing API-selected default.
- Adds one regression covering the banner, help and omitted request model. Explicit model behavior is preserved.
- Verified: all 284 CLI tests, build and scoped Biome; native default/explicit controls and 12 parent-review tests with the separate streamed-token fix.

Strict TypeScript diagnostics remain identical to the 36 existing baseline errors. Local tests used the already installed dependency cache.

gist.headline: Undefined leaves the chat
gist.blurb: The chat banner says `API default` when you skip `--model`. The API still picks the model; the terminal just tells the truth about it.
gist.summary: The Polli CLI chat banner displays `API default` instead of `undefined` when `--model` is omitted, and help text clarifies that the API selects the default model.
gist.impact: CLI users get an accurate banner and help text while requests without `--model` continue to leave model selection to the API; explicit model selection is unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Polli CLI as a cozy retro terminal with a chat banner reading 'API default'. Polli, wearing tiny terminal-operator glasses, points out the corrected label beside a small code-plant; the terminal represents the CLI, not a newly selected model.
